model.name: Qwen Image 2.1 Uncensored GGUF Q6_K 7B
model.description: Uncensored DiT GGUF Q6_K (5.9 GB) from abenzerps. Highest shipped uncensored quant (Q8_0 omitted: upstream shape mismatch). Same 2.1 VAE and Qwen3-VL-8B encoder. Mature Mode only. License follows Qwen Research License.
model.selector_help: Highest uncensored GGUF we ship. Needs Mature Mode. Still slower than INT8 ConvRot on a 4090.

resource_requirements.note: Q8_0 from this pack is not shipped (shape mismatch [136] vs [128]).
